description: Sovereign and geopolitical risk for AI compute infrastructure decisions. Returns risk assessment for key compute jurisdictions: Taiwan (fab concentration), South Korea (memory/HBM), Japan (equipment/materials), Netherlands (ASML/lithography), Singapore (regional hub), US (export controls), China (market access). Use when evaluating supply chain diversification, assessing export control exposure, or stress-testing procurement dependencies against geopolitical scenarios. Returns sovereign stability score per jurisdiction, active geopolitical alerts, cross-strait risk level, export control change probability (90d), and recommended diversification actions. 12h cache.
name: compute.sovereign_risk
